name: Otter Floss
subtitle: not to be confused with "flossing the otter"
rules: Draw a card. Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.

name: Perturb
subtitle: that's starting to get annoying
rules: Look at an opponent's hand and pick a non-resource card in it. That player discards that card. You may pick a card of the same type as the discarded card. If you do, put it into its owner's hand.

name: Perturbatious Warlock
subtitle: ting-tang wadda-wadda bing-bang
rules: When this card enters play, an opponent puts a card from their hand on the top of their deck.
flavor: "I'm sorry but I still can't love you. I don't want to get hurt again."

name: Reality Shift
subtitle: wat
rules: X is the total numeric cost of all non-resource cards you control. Put those cards into their owner's hand. You may deploy any number of cards for free with total numeric cost X or less. (You still need to meet their threshold and satisfy their extra costs.)
flavor: I reject your reality and substitute my own.

name: Redonkulous
subtitle: mortal enemy of the drama llama
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- If you deployed this card using FLIP UP, that character's controller discards 2 cards. If that character's controller has 3 or fewer cards in their hand, remove the character from the game. -- FLIP UP – 5 [O][O]

name: Rouse
subtitle: wise from your gwabe!
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a tactic in your discard pile. -- Put the tactic on the top of your deck. -- RECUR – [O][O][O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 1. Remove this card from the game. Pick a tactic in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the tactic on the top of your deck.

name: Sequestered Hellion
subtitle: not very frightening
rules: COVERT -- FLIP UP – 7 [O][O]
flavor: ...until it EATS you! Rarrrrrr!

name: Shrouded Demon
subtitle: it grabs them then eats their heads
rules: COVERT -- [O][O][O] – This card gains 2 life.
flavor: Except on Tuesdays, when it takes them bowling.

name: Sin Against Nature
subtitle: i should not exist
rules: When this card enters play, pick a resource you control. Put it into its owner's hand. (You may pick face-down resources.)
flavor: "Every moment I live is agony! Bleaurgghhhh!"

name: Stupidify
subtitle: when i snap my fingers you will be...stupid!
rules: An opponent discards 2 cards. -- RECUR – [O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – An opponent discards a card.

name: Thabbashite Haruspex
subtitle: your future is looking brown and veiny
rules: When this card enters or leaves play, you may draw a card. If you do, put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: ...and it doesn't smell very good, either.

name: Thabbashite Wizard
subtitle: i love a good potions book and a bodice ripper
rules: When this card enters play, each player may draw up to 2 cards.
flavor: "The philosopher's draught must be cured for three fortnights with a jewel of amber and the bile of a green tree-hen. His strong manly hands probed every crevice of her silken femininity, their undulating bodies writhing in sensual rhythm, as he thrust his purple-headed warrior into her quivering mound of love pudding."

name: The Abominable Hamster
subtitle: unholy fiend shat from the bowels of death
rules: COVERT -- [O][O][O][O][O] – This card gains 2 strength.
flavor: Though Death's publicist has since denied the entire incident.

name: Titillated Mooncalf
subtitle: secret languages are so Seed II
rules: When a card that provides at least [O] enters play under your control, you may pick a character. If you do, it gains COVERT this turn.

name: Tumescent Guilt Bladder
subtitle: repository of self deprecation
rules: At the end of your turn, put a token on this card. Your faction loses X influence, where X is the number of tokens on this card. You may play a resource. -- At the start of each turn, if there are at least 3 tokens on this card, an opponent takes control of it. Remove all tokens from this card.

name: Unbearable Torture
subtitle: no one withstands the machine
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- If the character's life is greater than it's strength, put it into the void. Draw a card. -- RECUR – [O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character in the void. -- EFFECT – Put the character on top of its owner's deck.
flavor: Do you hear that? That is the sound of ultimate suffering.
notes: Card itself prints "it's strength" (typo on the card, matches catalog).

name: Unimportant Wizard
subtitle: he was known as "the boy who was"
rules: FLIP UP – 0 [O]
flavor: No one was very impressed.

name: Verrucose Brains
subtitle: now with cream filling!
rules: At the end of each turn, put the character with the lowest numeric cost into its owner's hand. If there is a tie, you decide which character is affected.

name: Virulent Dogmatist
subtitle: BLARG!!!
rules: BERATE -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 2 strength or 1 speed.
flavor: "Shame on you youngsters an' your saggy collars!"

name: Wand of Possession
subtitle: making micromajigs better one zap at a time
rules: POSSESS -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Put a Micromajig token with COVERT into play.
flavor: No, they don't gain the "evil" subtype.

name: Wanton Wizard
subtitle: wizards are the worst
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a tactic in your discard pile. If you do, put it into play as a face-down resource under your control.
flavor: They're just the worst.

name: Witty Worm
subtitle: bookworm plus magic book
rules: While this card is in your hand you may reveal this card as you are playing a resource. If you do, you may deploy this card for 1. -- When this card enters play, you may put a resource you control into its owner's hand. If you do, you may play a resource.
notes: Footer also credits "original Open R&D game mechanic by kallisti" (bottom left, below the artist line).

name: Woadenworm Gloamspike, Thabbashite Prince
rules: UNIQUE GLOAMSPIKE -- All your face-down tactics gain FLIP UP with numeric cost and threshold equal to their regular numeric cost and threshold.
flavor: Betrayer, assassin, cult leader, loving husband and father of three children.
notes: Name is two lines, no subtitle line.

name: Wrinkly Rabbit
subtitle: taking the bugsy out of bunny
rules: COVERT -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each [O] you control.

name: Alluring Quicksand
subtitle: like taking a baby from its candy
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- Flip the character face-down under its owner's control. -- RECUR – [G][G][G][G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Flip the character face-down under its owner's control.

name: Architectural Restitution
subtitle: it's all good, we had a spare
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only while an opponent is attacking you. Pick a location in your discard pile. -- Put the location into play under your control. Change the target of that opponent's attack to the location. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G][G]

name: Auspicious Tax
subtitle: this is your brain on money
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character's controller must pay 3 to attack with it.
flavor: The real tragedy of the poor is the poverty of their aspirations

name: Avuncular Merlion
subtitle: rescue pirates can, la
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- When a character you control is put into your discard pile from play, you may pay 1 and remove a token from this card. If you do, put that character into play under your control. Deplete it.
flavor: "But keep some for uncle, la."

name: Balthassar Gristwalter
subtitle: parties so swanky the emperor is ashamed to attend
rules: UNIQUE BALTHASSAR -- SCHMOOZE -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: "You know what you do, you buy the wine in Geldale, then you get on the train and you go to Yenassa and you buy a manchild, and then you eat the manchild and you drink the wine and you look at the ocean and it is a beautiful thing... mwah!"

name: Because God Said So!
subtitle: i have it on good authority
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a blocking character. -- This turn, the character gains 5 strength and 5 life.
flavor: Thou shalt stone not once but thrice in the head those who blaspheme against god, and mash yon girly men with ye giant masher, and rend unto fire those unloved by the children of god, yea, and death unto fat chicks.

name: Black Scourge of the Brine
subtitle: you mean oil?
rules: ENCROACH – [G][G][G][G][G] -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.
flavor: "No, I mean black scourge of the brine!"

name: Caboodling Gladhander
subtitle: hey! great to see you ol' pal!
rules: EXTRA COST – You may pick a character. -- When this card enters play, if you picked a character as part of its cost, destroy that character. That character's controller's faction gains X influence, where X is the strength of that character.

name: Caracal Morphnus
subtitle: reputed to be twice as frightening as Vilghame was fierce
rules: UNIQUE CARACAL -- When this card enters play, put 5 tokens on it. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- When you draw any number of cards, put X tokens on this card, where X is the number of cards drawn. -- $$$ MORPH -- COST – Remove 3 tokens from this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.

name: Ceremonious Groomer
subtitle: licking perfection
rules: If this card would be destroyed, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead.
flavor: Occupational hazards include: thrush, leukoplakia, and fur balls.

name: Chancellor of Reinstatement
subtitle: repurposes the purposeless
rules: REINSTATE -- COST – Pay 4. Destroy this card. Pick a character in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character into play under your control if it has numeric cost X or less, where X is the number of [G] you control.
flavor: "You! You're a baker now. And you... a phlebotomist."

name: Circumspect Hijacker
subtitle: don't be alarmed, we're taking over the ship
rules: [G][G][G] – When this card enters play, draw a card. -- RETREAT -- COST – Pay 2. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: "Commandeer. We're going to commandeer that ship. Nautical term."

name: Clam Hash
subtitle: mmm...claaam haaash...
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- This turn, the character gains 2 life. If you deployed this card using FLIP UP, put this card into its owner's hand instead of their discard pile. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G][G]

name: Crushing Usury
subtitle: no, no, the usury part comes later
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- Destroy the character. Your faction loses 3 influence. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G]
flavor: ...after they get the clothes off.

name: D3ck W4rd3n
subtitle: lolz t3h c4p741n 15 4 pu55y!!!!!11oneone
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 2 influence.
flavor: 15 n00bz 0n 4 d34d d00dz ch357 roflmao 4nd 4 b07713 0f rum
notes: Name and flavor are printed in leetspeak.

name: Delectable Boon
subtitle: MINE!
rules: EXTRA COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X. Pick 2 characters, locations, and/or factions. -- The next X damage that would be inflicted to the first picked card this turn is inflicted to the second picked card instead.
flavor: Get your own.
notes: Footer also credits "original Open R&D concept by Iskariot & kallisti" (bottom left, below the artist line).

name: Department of Rejections
subtitle: nope
rules: Your opponents must pay 2 to search their deck. -- Your opponents must pay 2 to use a character's ability. (This includes abilities used when the character is not in play.) -- FLIP UP – 1 [G]
flavor: PLEASE TRY AGAIN NEVER

name: Derelict Seafarer
subtitle: it's hardly an ideal world
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 3 influence. Put a random card from your discard pile into your hand. -- RETIRE – [G][G][G] -- COST – Use this only while this card is not in a battle. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 3 [G]
flavor: In an ideal world, I'd have all 10 fingers on my right hand so my left hand would just be a fist for punching.

name: Desserted Island
subtitle: where witches outgrow their gingerbread houses
rules: Draw 3 cards. -- RECUR – [G][G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 1. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: Nothing but fudge, cookies, and the bleached white bones of diabetic castaways.
notes: Artist credit reads "Patrick Meehan" with no "& TGA".

name: Dowsing Cleric
subtitle: let's see...50 paces north...then 20 paces east...
rules: When this card enters or leaves play, you may search your deck for a staple resource, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
flavor: "If you can think of a better way to find water, I'd looove to hear it."

name: Dwarvish Grimalkin
subtitle: judge me by my size, do you?
rules: [G][G] – When this card enters play, draw a card. -- [G][G][G][G][G] – When this card enters play, draw a card. -- [G][G][G][G][G][G][G][G][G] – When this card enters play, draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G]
